column7: God never takes you down! He will never run you down; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He is speaking from the frame of reference that everything the Word says about you has already been accomplished and ACCEPTED by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you **GREAT AND MIGHTY** things which you do not know.” Does that sound like running you down or doom and gloom? There is NO doom and gloom in God, therefore He cannot tell you anything doomy or gloomy. You’ll have to tune in to the world’s news agency for doom and gloom.
column8: God never lets you fall! He will never belittle you; He only builds you up. When God speaks to you, He does so from this point of reference: that everything the Word has said about you has already been accomplished and has already been received by you. Jeremiah 33:3 says: “Call to Me, and I will answer you, and show you great and unsearchable things which you do not know.” Does that sound like belittling you, or like gloom and despair? There is no gloom or despair in God, so He cannot tell you anything gloomy or bleak. If you want to hear gloom and despair, you need to tune in to the news agencies of this world.

column7: Now, if God THINKS good thoughts of peace, a future, and hope toward us, why would He speak otherwise? The answer is, HE WOULDN’T, and HE DOESN’T! He only leads us UPWARD and ONWARD with great hope to provide us an expected future.
column8: Since God has good plans for us to give us peace, a future, and hope，why would He ever say the opposite? The answer is: He never would, and He has not! He will only lead us upward、forward with great hope, to give us the future we hope for。
